scope: Ten deep accounts of 10000 subjects in one database
baseline: The prepared arm estimates 260–350 durable saves/s at saturation from the prior work. These forecasts cover the writer and its existing per-member speculative evaluation.
mechanism: K shares the native receipt and journal metadata. P trades seven or fewer separately indexed journal facts for one frame and extra identity/restore seeks. Reply fan-out should use under 1 ms per physical group and narrower HTTP bodies cannot remove Datomic's native payload or per-member speculation.
timeBudget: The estimated 8 ms arm is unchanged. At 235 offered saves/s, the predicted live-only isolation miss remains above 1.25 times quiet-alone p99.
fallback: Every arm uses the same experiment-defined dense journal IDs. The packed arm charges fallback journals if exact byte reconstruction or ID reservation fails.
